levels.surface: أبي نعيم محمد بن أحمد الانصاري

notes: «عنه» opens the report and prev1 (226) writes its chain; how much of that chain «عنه» takes over is not settled, so it is written as back_reference as it stands
The narrative relays the words of Abu Abdullah and Amir al-Mu'minin inside the account (rule 11, the Imam speaks in a narrated scene); whether he is a source is a ruling case
«كنت حاضرا» is Abu Nu'aym's own account: he is the last link
